tools.name: gorilladesk_get_company
tools.description: Get the company that owns this API key. Good first call. GET /v1/company.

tools.name: gorilladesk_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the company. GET /v1/users.

tools.name: gorilladesk_get_user
tools.description: Get one staff user by id. GET /v1/users/{userId}.

tools.name: gorilladesk_list_customers
tools.description: List customers. Filter by status, account number, or created or updated dates. GET /v1/customers.

tools.name: gorilladesk_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, optionally with its locations and contacts. GET /v1/customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: gorilladesk_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer with its first location (the API requires a location). Creates a new record each call; do not repeat it. POST /v1/customers.

tools.name: gorilladesk_update_customer
tools.description: Update a customer. The API needs first_name on every update. PUT /v1/customers/{customerId}. Not verified on a real account: send every field you want kept, because PUT may clear fields you leave out. Read the customer first with gorilladesk_get_customer.

tools.name: gorilladesk_add_customer_location
tools.description: Add a service location to an existing customer. POST /v1/customers/{customerId}/locations.

tools.name: gorilladesk_add_customer_note
tools.description: Add a note to a customer record. Creates a new note each call. POST /v1/customers/{customerId}/notes (multipart form).

tools.name: gorilladesk_list_leads
tools.description: List inbound leads by source and creation date. GET /v1/leads.

tools.name: gorilladesk_create_lead
tools.description: Create an inbound lead. Creates a new lead each call. POST /v1/leads.

tools.name: gorilladesk_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs, filtered by customer, state, keyword or job date. GET /v1/jobs.

tools.name: gorilladesk_get_job
tools.description: Get one job by id, optionally with its customer, location, schedules and sold_by. GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}.

tools.name: gorilladesk_list_job_activities
tools.description: List the activity records of one job, optionally between two dates. GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}/activities.

tools.name: gorilladesk_list_job_statuses
tools.description: List the job statuses of the company. GET /v1/job-statuses.

tools.name: gorilladesk_list_schedules
tools.description: List the company's schedules. GET /v1/schedules.

tools.name: gorilladesk_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, filtered by customer, job, status or issue date. GET /v1/invoices.

tools.name: gorilladesk_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, optionally with its customer, location and items. GET /v1/invoices/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: gorilladesk_list_estimates
tools.description: List estimates (quotes), filtered by customer, job, status or date. GET /v1/estimates.

tools.name: gorilladesk_list_payments
tools.description: List payments received, filtered by customer, invoice, status or date. GET /v1/payments.

tools.name: gorilladesk_list_line_items
tools.description: List the company's line items. GET /v1/items.

tools.name: gorilladesk_list_service_templates
tools.description: List the company's service templates. GET /v1/services.

tools.name: gorilladesk_list_time_entries
tools.description: List technician clock-in and clock-out entries, filtered by user or clock-in time. GET /v1/time-entries.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gorilladesk_list_invoices · Private data: gorilladesk_get_company, gorilladesk_get_customer, gorilladesk_create_customer, gorilladesk_add_customer_note, gorilladesk_list_job_activities · Public sink: gorilladesk_create_customer, gorilladesk_update_customer, gorilladesk_add_customer_location, gorilladesk_add_customer_note, gorilladesk_create_lead.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gorilladesk_list_invoices · Private data: gorilladesk_get_company, gorilladesk_get_customer, gorilladesk_create_customer, gorilladesk_add_customer_note, gorilladesk_list_job_activities · Public sink: gorilladesk_create_customer, gorilladesk_update_customer, gorilladesk_add_customer_location, gorilladesk_add_customer_note, gorilladesk_create_lead

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
